evidence: Modifies test framework utilities `p2p.py` and `util.py` to use condition variables instead of fixed polling sleeps.
rationale: Substantially cuts functional test suite run times by replacing fixed 50ms polling sleeps with condition variable notifications. Author and independent tester benchmarks show a 7.5%–11% reduction in suite wall time and a 12%–17.5% decrease in accumulated CPU time, significantly lowering the recurring burden of CI and local test runs.
